title: Executive order.
bodyText: The governor may execute any executive order, memorandum, or directive necessary to implement any provision of this chapter.
bodyHtml: [§201M-9]  Executive order.  The governor may execute any executive order, memorandum, or directive necessary to implement any provision of this chapter. [L 1998, c 168, pt of §2, §5; am L 2002, c 202, §5]
